correctness.rationale: For arbitrary complex symmetric trace-free A=B+iC, Gaussian quadratic-form cumulants give the exact fourth-moment numerator 4|tr A^2|^2+8t^2+32r+16s with r=||A^2||_F^2 and s=tr((AA*)^2). Direct trace expansion yields r+s=2tr(B^2+C^2)^2. Subtracting 2(n+2)/(n+6) times squared L2 gives the asserted exact nonnegative three-term identity in every n>=2. Equality forces A^2=0 and B^2=C^2=t/(2n)I; invertible anticommuting real symmetric involutions require even n and reduce orthogonally to the block Clifford pair, which realizes equality. A separate standard-library integer-polynomial moment enumerator, verify.py, checked 84 complete cases including four exact equality examples; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

The theorem supplies an all-even-dimension exact endpoint, a quantitative three-square stability certificate, a complete canonical equality orbit, and a parity obstruction to equality in odd ambient dimension. The improvement over Jensen and the distinct lower endpoint are mathematically motivated rather than an arbitrary numerical slice; odd-dimension optimal values remain unclaimed.
